title: Jellyfin: free Plex Pass alternative
caption:
Plex Remote Watch Pass charges $29.99/year to stream your own movies outside your home. Jellyfin does it for free 🎬

✅ Turns your movies and shows into your own streaming library
✅ Watch on your phone, TV or browser
✅ Posters, cast and ratings, and it remembers where you stopped
✅ No premium tier, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ You run the server on your own computer, and it has to stay on for you to stream

Comment "MOVIES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #selfhosted #movies #plex #homeserver #freeapps #techtips
